title: Relay App Workflow Run
description: A workflow run instance in Relay.app, representing a single execution of a workflow including its status, timing, and input/output data.

id.description: The unique identifier of the workflow run.

workflowId.description: The ID of the workflow being run.

status.description: Current status of the workflow run.

startedAt.description: Date and time the run was started.

completedAt.description: Date and time the run was completed.

error.description: Error message if the run failed.

inputData.description: Input data provided when the run was triggered.
